summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against all four paragraphs of the selected Greek source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the three anxious questions, God/Lord distinction, modifier attached to sins, narrative details, speaker attribution, emphatic denial and certainty, conditional evil desire, and full scope of Hermas’s virtues. Reader-facing servant follows current policy. The notes disclose difficult lexical choices and reported witness alternatives without replacing the working readings; they distinguish first hand from correction and editorial supplementation from preserved text. Their bounded witness descriptions are consistent with the supplied project report. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the selected working source and disclosure within the supplied materials, not authentication of unseen manuscripts, independent scholarly certification, or exhaustive collation.
